description: This source file defines the LiveCommand interface, which extends Command and WithThingId, providing methods to handle live commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes a method to create an answer builder for responding to commands, and is part of the package handling live command processing.

classes.name: LiveCommand
classes.description: An interface for live commands providing methods to generate command responses and emit events, parameterized by the command type and answer builder type.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Returns a builder for creating responses or events to respond to the command, used for emitting command responses or events.
